tools.name: check_cabal_risk
tools.description:
Pre-trade safety check for any Solana token mint: is a buyer about to be
someone's exit liquidity? Every wallet cluster carries its evidence_txs.

AFTER YOU BUY: POST /api/watch {mint, webhook_url} with an X-API-Key (a
free key is enough) and we push you an alert the moment a coordinated dump
or liq

tools.name: check_wallet_in_token
tools.description:
Is a SPECIFIC wallet involved in a SPECIFIC Solana token? Use this when a
user names a wallet they are worried about, or when your agent keeps its
own watchlist of addresses and wants to screen a token against one.

Answers from two sources at once:
  1. the traced holders of that token — rank, % of

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_cabal_risk" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_cabal_risk, check_wallet_in_token · Private data: check_cabal_risk, check_wallet_in_token · Public sink: check_cabal_risk, check_wallet_in_token · Destructive: check_cabal_risk.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_cabal_risk, check_wallet_in_token · Private data: check_cabal_risk, check_wallet_in_token · Public sink: check_cabal_risk, check_wallet_in_token · Destructive: check_cabal_risk

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_cabal_risk" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
